text:
Sophie L: Heads up — Orchid Analytics (acct OA-1147) pinged support: they were charged full price for April even though they were in the experimental tier discount (SPRING_TRIAL). They expect a refund because their usage spiked due to ingest testing. Invoice INV-2026-0407 shows $6,350 billed but expected $4,445 after 30% experimental discount.

Ben (Customer): Confirmed — our portal shows the SPRING_TRIAL badge active on billing settings. Screenshot attached in support ticket. We need a refund applied; prefer a refund to card rather than account credit.

Ava (Support): Thanks Ben, filing to Finance. Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/tickets/TSK-9981. Including portal screenshot and promo state.

Daniel (Billing): Looking at pricing-experiments service logs — SPRING_TRIAL was toggled off for the account at 2026-04-01 03:12 UTC due to a rollout script, but the customer UI still displayed the badge (UI cache lag). So the billing run didn't apply the discount.

Rafael (Revenue Ops): For refunds to card we need approval from Finance leadership and check for revenue recognition impact. How big is the delta?

Sophie L: Quick numbers pasted by customer:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0407
Billed: $6,350.00
Expected (30% SPRING_TRIAL): $4,445.00
Refund needed: $1,905.00
```

Rafael (Revenue Ops): Approve refund to card up to $2,000 as a one-time customer accommodation; note that we'll offset recognized revenue next month. Please record JE for audit.

Daniel (Billing): Approved by Rafael. I'll create refund REF-10322 for $1,905. Processing as card refund per customer request. I'll also create manual journal JE-45820 and flag for revenue ops reconciliation.

BillingBot: Refund initiated: REF-10322 | Amount: $1,905.00 | Invoice: INV-2026-0407 | Status: processing.

Daniel (Billing): Payment gateway shows refund settled. REF-10322 status: completed. JE-45820 posted. Note: we issued refund to card; customer requested this specifically.

Ava (Support): I'll confirm delivery to the customer and update ticket TSK-9981 with refund proof and JE ref.

Rafael (Revenue Ops): Also opening a follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRICEXP-304 to add a CI check so UI cache state and billing eligibility are reconciled before charging. Assigning to infra and billing.

Sophie L: Thanks everyone. Can we also add a small goodwill credit of $50 for the customer effort? If so, please apply as account credit.

Daniel (Billing): Adding ADJ-90231 for $50 as goodwill credit, applied to OA-1147. BillingBot will post ledger note.

BillingBot: Adjustment created: ADJ-90231 | Amount: $50.00 | Account: OA-1147 | Status: posted. JE-45821 created.

Ben (Customer): Appreciate the fast turnaround, thanks Sophie and team. :smile:
